name: Atelier
signature: Full-width acid marquee ticker plus display type set at 9.5rem with -.055em tracking
description: Near-black studio with an acid-lime charge — oversized uppercase display and a running marquee. Logo family: truchet quarter-arc tiles.

name: Blueprint
signature: Fixed 24/120px engineering grid over the whole page plus red dimension lines with end ticks
description: Drafting-table architecture studio — live engineering grid, dimension callouts, spec-table services. Logo family: modular_grid mirrored-cell bitmap.

name: Contour
signature: Eight-band topographic contour field behind the hero plus an MGA2020 coordinate readout strip
description: Forest-and-hi-vis surveying practice — topographic contour field and a live coordinate readout. Logo family: line_weave plain weave.

name: Counsel
signature: Hairline double rule with a § pivot, brass crest, and serif drop caps opening each body block
description: Bottle-green and brass law practice — crest, drop caps, double rules, quiet authority. Logo family: superellipse_crest Lamé-curve badge.

name: Datum
signature: Isometric wireframe structure behind the hero and a monospaced spec-table service list keyed to AS standards
description: Slate-and-amber engineering consultancy — isometric hairline structure, monospaced spec tables. Logo family: line_weave plain weave.

name: Halcyon
signature: Fully-rounded capsule slots and cards plus a dotted range-of-motion arc
description: Sage-and-teal allied-health clinic — capsule geometry, live booking panel, unhurried tone. Logo family: circle_packing Vogel phyllotaxis.

name: Ledger
signature: Ruled ledger paper (repeating 2.2rem rules + red margin line) and tabular-figure data rows
description: Ruled-paper accounting practice — oxblood rules, tabular figures, everything reconciles. Logo family: modular_grid mirrored-cell bitmap.

name: Meridian
signature: Concentric meridian arcs rising to a hairline horizon, plus a four-cell tabular stat band
description: Midnight-navy wealth practice — gold horizon arcs, tabular stat band, hushed confidence. Logo family: golden_monogram Fibonacci spiral.

name: Quorum
signature: A visible numbered 12-column grid ruler that every section aligns to, with a single red accent
description: Swiss-grid consultancy — white, black, one red mark, and an exposed 12-column ruler. Logo family: modular_grid mirrored-cell bitmap.

name: Sigil
signature: Mathematically drawn guilloché rosette (12 ellipses rotated 15° apart) plus a fixed engraved double page border
description: Maroon-and-gold notarial office — guilloché seal, engraved page border, multilingual. Logo family: superellipse_crest Lamé-curve badge.

name: Solace
signature: An 11-second breathing radial halo behind the hero, soft radii everywhere, no hard edges
description: Plum-and-lavender psychology practice — a slowly breathing halo and 1.9 line-height calm. Logo family: circle_packing Vogel phyllotaxis.

name: Terrace
signature: Arched terrace-window panels (999px top radius) and a 44×11px brick module strip
description: Terracotta-and-sand property advisory — arched terrace windows, brick module rhythm. Logo family: golden_monogram Fibonacci spiral.

name: Logo family: golden_monogram (φ-rectangle Fibonacci spiral)
lineage: Used by styles: Meridian, Terrace (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: φ-rectangle subdivision chain — each square contributes a quarter-circle forming a Fibonacci spiral, initials in the largest square, subdivision rules as hairlines
description: Parametric deterministic mark family: golden-rectangle subdivision whose quarter-circles chain into a Fibonacci spiral. 3 seeded samples (e.g. Ledger & Bowe, Harrow & Vane, Meridian Private Wealth); all 6 families rendered together in logos/showcase.html at 16/48/200px plus true-size business cards.

name: Logo family: superellipse_crest (Lamé curve badge)
lineage: Used by styles: Counsel, Sigil (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: Three nested superellipse rings (n∈[2.6,4.4], seeded, stepping down 0.55 per ring) with a chevron bar at 100/φ² units up the baseline
description: Lamé superellipse crest — nested rings tighten inward for an institutional badge read. 3 seeded samples (Kell & Ostrowski, Halcyon Physiotherapy, Studio Perrin); see logos/showcase.html.

name: Logo family: line_weave (plain weave lattice)
lineage: Used by styles: Datum, Contour (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: N×N warp/weft lattice where the over-strand is real geometry — the under-strand is broken with a 1.5× band-width gap so it genuinely passes behind
description: True plain-weave geometry with real over/under crossings (seeded parity), bands ≥7 units with round caps. 3 seeded samples (Datum Consulting Engineers, Kostas Notary & Migration, Ashgrove Buyers Agency); see logos/showcase.html.

name: Logo family: circle_packing (Vogel phyllotaxis)
lineage: Used by styles: Halcyon, Solace (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: Sunflower packing at the golden angle 137.507° with r=c·√i — densest non-lattice disc packing, discs pushed clear of an initials core
description: Vogel phyllotaxis disc packing around a central initials core; discs decay with radius and are dropped (not clipped) at the rim. 3 seeded samples (Beacon Land Surveyors, Quorum Advisory, Still Point Psychology); see logos/showcase.html.

name: Logo family: modular_grid (mirrored cell bitmap)
lineage: Used by styles: Ledger, Blueprint, Quorum (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: 5×5 bitmap with columns 3–4 mirroring seeded columns 0–2, forced centre spine, isolated pixels pruned, faint construction grid at 25% opacity
description: Mirror-symmetric 5×5 cell bitmap over a visible construction grid — symmetry is the trick separating a deliberate mark from noise. 3 seeded samples (Pemberton & Roe, Northwind Advisory, Calder Veterinary); see logos/showcase.html.

name: Logo family: truchet (Smith quarter-arc tiles)
lineage: Used by styles: Atelier (per tokens.json logo_family)
signature: Truchet tiles: every cell holds two quarter-circles anchored NW/SE or NE/SW by one seeded bit — since each edge is crossed at its midpoint, curves always join
description: Smith-variant Truchet arc field (1704 principle) that can never break, centred on a badge plate carrying the initials. 3 seeded samples (Oakhaven Dental, Ferrier & Mills, Silverbrook Legal); see logos/showcase.html.

name: x10.au Directory v1 (Green + Gold)
lineage: Variants iteration 1 — rework of the samples/v1 original green+gold rendition
signature: Green+gold panel with radial gold/green glows pinned to opposite corners and gold hairline borders
description: First variants iteration of the x10.au directory: dark forest-green surfaces with muted green (#4A6B47/#6E9A6A) accents and gold (#C9A24E) highlights, Fraunces serif display over Inter.

name: x10.au Directory v2 (Parchment Editorial)
lineage: Variants iteration 2 — introduces a parchment (#F4EFE3) editorial layer and leaner token set
signature: Dark green+gold base with a contrasting parchment ink-on-paper surface mode driven by --parchment/--parchment-ink tokens
description: Iteration 2 of the x10.au directory: same green+gold dark base but with a dedicated parchment light layer (--parchment #F4EFE3, ink #1a1f19) and Fraunces-led serif emphasis for an editorial index feel.

name: x10.au Directory v3 (Refined Green + Gold)
lineage: Variants iteration 3 — refines v1 with dedicated --hero-bg/--cta-bg/--cta-ink tokens; lighter file than v1/v2
signature: Green+gold panel formalised into hero/CTA tokens: gradient CTA band (135deg #111611→#1a221a) over a transparent hero
description: Iteration 3 of the x10.au directory: slimmer 45KB build that keeps the v1 green+gold system but formalises hero and CTA treatment into explicit tokens; copy pivots to Legal/Finance/Tech/Health categories.

name: x10.au Directory FINAL (Space Grotesk Green + Gold)
useCases: Sydney business directory for professionals & specialists
lineage: Final build — adopts font-sampler pairing #1 (Space Grotesk + Inter), dropping the Fraunces+Inter pairing rejected as 'AI-generic'; supersedes v3; keeps index.html.bak-geo / .bak-rebuild / .pre-final-bak iterations inline
signature: Green+gold panel with sharp Space Grotesk headings, gold x-marks in headings, gradient CTA band and gold hairline tiles
description: The final x10.au directory rendition: the established dark green+gold system (bg #0b0e0b, green #6E9A6A, gold #C9A24E) re-set in Space Grotesk + Inter + JetBrains Mono after the font-pairing review. In-page backups record the geo and rebuild passes that led here.

name: x10.au Font Pairing Sampler (sharp / professional)
useCases: Type specimen board for the directory brand
lineage: Decision tool that produced variants/final — notes pairing F (Fraunces+Inter) as the rejected 'AI-generic' reference; candidate pairings: Space Grotesk+Inter, Archivo+IBM Plex Sans, Sora+Manrope, Familjen Grotesk+Spline Sans, Instrument Sans+Libre Franklin, IBM Plex Sans+IBM Plex Mono
signature: Six numbered pairing cards each rendering the same hero heading, lede and category tiles on the shared green+gold panel for direct comparison
description: Single-page type specimen that loads 14 Google families and renders six sharper/professional pairings of the x10.au directory hero + tiles side by side. Pairing #1 (Space Grotesk + Inter) was carried into variants/final.

name: x10.au Original Sample (Green + Gold)
useCases: Sydney health, wellness & beauty pros directory
lineage: The original rendition — predecessor of variants/v1; category focus later broadened from health/wellness/beauty to all professional services
signature: The founding green+gold panel: dark forest surfaces, muted green accents, gold soft-glow highlights and Fraunces display type
description: The original x10.au sample page — the first green+gold dark directory rendition, aimed at Sydney health, wellness & beauty pros. Its palette and structure seeded the whole variants/v1→v3→final lineage and the gold accent later reused across the design studio.
